text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way home from a day out
together,
Yamanin Zephyr and I run into
a few friends.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's Zephyr! Were you out with your
trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We were out to savor the tender
and sunlit
breeze on this lovely day.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That sounds nice! We went out to try
camping,
but we came back 'cause we
couldn't...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yep. The campsite was just way too
crowded.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I assumed a reservation would be
unnecessary
since the location's
restricted to daytime use, but
the recent
camping craze is not to be

underestimated.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, what an ill turn of the currents...
Quite a
shame, given how agreeable the
air was today.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I do... They don't have the usual
amenities,
but if you don't mind that, I
could take you to
one?
choice_data_list: ゼファーなら穴場を知っているんじゃない？
choice_data_list_en: I bet Zephyr knows a good hidden gem, doesn't she?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please! If it's somewhere with your
seal of
approval, it's bound to make for
a real authentic
camping experience!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We follow Yamanin Zephyr, and the
secret spot
she takes us to is... a hidden
stream in the
mountains!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
There's a river! And over there, there's a
waterfall!
This is amazing! It's like a
picture-perfect
campsite!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
This is one of my favorite places. It's a
nice place
to rest while enjoying the
azure winds of the east.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Wait, we came empty-handed. I just
remembered
we were planning to rent
equipment on-site... We
should've at
least brought a mat to sit on.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, we'll be all right. The forest
has
everything we need.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr begins piling up some
fallen
branches that still have their
leaves.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There, our own little nest to sit in. The
elasticity
of the branches and the
softness of the leaves
make it quite light
and airy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We set about making our camping
"nest". It's a
little tricky to arrange the
branches, but we all
manage.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaand... done! Ooh, it looks pretty
comfy!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This has more cushioning than a real
camping
mat. How impressive!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Look at all these berries I picked
from the
tree! Apparently, they're all
safe to eat, too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I went and got some spring water, so we
can make
tea. Let's all have a nice drink
together.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... These berries are surprisingly
palatable.
They're tart but subtly sweet.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Hm? Zephyr? What are you—
choice_data_list: お茶も爽やかで美味しい！
choice_data_list_en: The tea is refreshing and delicious, too!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After suddenly dashing off towards the
river,
Yamanin Zephyr walks straight into
the water and
plunges her hands
beneath the surface!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hold on a sec! What's gotten into you?!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's lunchtime, so I thought I'd catch
some fish to
eat.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to do that! Look at you!
You're
soaked!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry. A little splash like this
is barely a
wisp in the wind. I'm very
used to fishing like this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Getting swept up in a whirlwind
alongside the
fishies is one of the purest
thrills camping can
offer. The next fishie
I see is mine... Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
That looks like fun! I wanna catch one
too!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Yes, freshly caught, salt-grilled
fish is
exactly the kind of gourmet
cuisine that's
exclusive to camping
excursions. Allow me to
help!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geez... "Gourmet cuisine"? All right, you
got me.
Wouldn't want to be the odd
one out! Hyup!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Turbo! That's right... Swim this way...
HAH!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ooooh! Nice catch, Zephyr!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I did it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying a very Zephyr-esque
camping
experience, we head back to
the academy and
part ways in front of
the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The still of evening came out of
nowhere, didn't
it? I suppose everyone's
tuckered out after all our
activities.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fun...
choice_data_list: ゼファーは疲れてない？

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm used to the wind of solitude when
camping,
but today's extended current...
made for a
refreshing guise.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I would. It might be nice to share the
bracing
breeze with others from time to
time.
choice_data_list_en: Do you want to come here with everyone again?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'm not. In fact, I still feel the harmonious
breeze.
I feel I could have stayed out
longer.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Next time...
choice_data_list_en: We'll save the rest for next time.
We'll save the rest for next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr quietly ponders the
meaning of
those words. I can't help
feeling that, deep down
inside her, a
subtle change is taking place.
